message.content:
**Answer:**  
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.

| Market | Approximate annual visitors (latest available) | Notes |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|-------|
| Union Square Greenmarket | ~1.5 million (NYC Dept. of Agriculture, 2019) | Largest and most‑visited farmers’ market in NYC; open Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun. |

*Union Square Greenmarket* consistently draws the highest foot traffic among all NYC farmers’ markets, thanks to its central location, diverse vendor mix, and strong community engagement.
